senses.definition: vb. prob. drip (cf. either Arabic ذَرَفَ shed tears, or Aramaic ܙܳܪܺܝܦܬܳܐ imber vehemens)—
יַזְרִיף read in ψ 72:6 by Hup Bi Che (for זַרְזִיף) sq. אָ֑רֶץ cause to drip, irrigate.
